title: Sauteed Bell Peppers and Onion with Olives and Meyer Lemon
description: Sauteed bell peppers and sweet onion are mixed up with oil-cured olives and fresh Meyer lemon in this side dish or salad that's quick and easy to prepare.
ingredients: 10 oil-cured black olives, pitted and chopped
1 orange bell pepper, sliced into strips
1 yellow bell pepper, sliced into strips
1 large sweet onion, sliced into strips

steps.text: Cut ends off of the lemon, then cut lemon in half. Chop half of the lemon into small pieces, peel included; squeeze other lemon half and save juice.
Combine olives with 2 tablespoon oil, oregano, chopped lemon, and lemon juice.

Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Saute bell peppers and onion in the hot oil until onion is limp and peppers are still a little crunchy, about 5 minutes. Mix hot mixture into lemon mixture. Add salt and pepper. Serve immediately.
